items.title: Seaboard Marine Launches Fastest Direct Service from Colombia to U.S. Northeast with New Weekly Calls to Gloucester
items.summary: Seaboard Marine is proud to introduce a significant enhancement to its North Atlantic service, delivering the fastest transit time of any ocean carrier from Colombia to the U.S. Northeast. Beginning Thursday, June 26, 2025, Seaboard Marine will offer direct weekly sailings from Santa Marta, Colombia, arriving every Monday at the Gloucester Marine Terminal.
